metadata_hints.metric: F1 (bag-of-tokens overlap, max over gold answers) and Exact Match (EM); F1 is the headline metric
metadata_hints.n_items_test: Hidden test: ~10% of 536 articles (46 articles); exact question count not stated in paper (implied 107,785 - 87,599 train - 10,570 dev = 9,616; unverified). De-facto standard for papers is the public dev set: 10,570 questions / 48 articles (train 87,599 / 442 articles)
metadata_hints.score_at_release_system: Logistic regression with hand-engineered features (authors' baseline)
metadata_hints.score_at_release_setting: Supervised, trained on SQuAD train; hidden test F1 51.0 / EM 40.4 (dev F1 51.0 / EM 40.0); sliding-window baseline ~20% F1. No external leaderboard entries at launch (first: Match-LSTM, Aug 27 2016, 70.695 F1)
metadata_hints.lineage: v1.0 released with paper (2016-06); v1.1 revision is what the official leaderboard and public dev JSON use; successor SQuAD 2.0 (2018-06, adds 50k+ adversarial unanswerable questions); derivatives include Adversarial SQuAD (Jia & Liang 2017-07), QNLI task in GLUE (2018-04), XQuAD (translation of v1.1 dev, 2019)
metadata_hints.known_contamination_or_defects: Adversarial distractor sentences cut 16 published models' average F1 from 75% to 36% (Jia & Liang 2017, https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.07328); creators note the v1 human score (single human) underestimates human accuracy (https://arxiv.org/abs/1806.03822). Source passages are Wikipedia, which is in nearly all LLM pretraining corpora

metadata_hints.metric: SuperGLUE score = unweighted average over 8 tasks (multi-metric tasks averaged first: CB acc/F1, MultiRC F1a/EM, ReCoRD F1/EM; accuracy otherwise)
metadata_hints.n_items_test: ~17.6k test examples over 8 tasks (BoolQ 3,245; CB 250; COPA 500; MultiRC 1,800; ReCoRD ~10k; RTE 300; WiC 1,400; WSC 146) plus diagnostics AX-b and AX-g. arXiv v1 (2019-05) had only 6 tasks (CB, COPA, MultiRC, RTE, WiC, WSC; 4,396 test examples)
metadata_hints.score_at_release_system: BERT++ (BERT-large with intermediate training on related tasks, e.g., MNLI)
metadata_hints.score_at_release_setting: Final 8-task benchmark, test via leaderboard (BERT 69.0). arXiv v1 (6 tasks): BERT++ 69.7, BERT 66.6
metadata_hints.lineage: Successor to GLUE (2018-04); task set grew from 6 tasks (arXiv v1, 2019-05) to 8 (arXiv v2, 2019, adding BoolQ and ReCoRD); clones include Russian SuperGLUE (2020-10)
metadata_hints.known_contamination_or_defects: None specific found in sources reviewed; constituent tasks (e.g., RTE, WSC, COPA) predate the benchmark and are widely circulated online
